subject: english
stem: The school office has sent the following message. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: light rain is expected after noon near the music room
heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room
heavy rain is expected before three thirty near the music room
heavy rain is expected after noon near the community hall

optionRationales.reason: light rain is expected after noon near the music room：此項把「heavy」改成「light」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。
heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。

heavy rain is expected before three thirty near the music room：此項把「after noon」改成「before three thirty」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。

heavy rain is expected after noon near the community hall：此項把「music room」改成「community hall」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：逐句比對鎖定逐字稿，答案為「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」。
獨立覆核 B：重新依時間順序核對說話者、細節與行動，只有「heavy rain is expected after noon near the music room」成立。
